incidents.name: YYS sell contract priced from manipulable pair reserves
incidents.notes: The YYS investment contract buys YYS back at the YYS/BUSDT pair's live rate, so the attacker used a PancakeV3 flash loan to push the pair price up before selling 38,584 YYS into the contract.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xcC0F0f41f4c4c17493517dd6c6d9DD1aDb134Fc9 created 2024-05-28T13:47:50Z by 0x44e3221cd4318b58a06a35a22efffccfe7d318eb, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x101723def8695f5bb8d5d4aa70869c10b5ff6340; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
